events.what: Gong, Wu, Xie and Yu prove the rational strong Novikov conjecture for groups acting by volume-preserving diffeomorphisms (arXiv:1811.02086, GAFA 2021)
Gong, Wu, Xie and Yu prove the rational strong Novikov conjecture for countable discrete subgroups of Diff(M), removing the volume-preserving hypothesis (arXiv:2310.01219)

judgement.doubts: The only post-snapshot activity is the Aug 2024 and Feb 2025 revisions of arXiv:2310.01219; the record shows no new mathematics in them (the v1 title and abstract framing already cover the full diffeomorphism group). If a diff showed the non-volume-preserving theorem was only established in a revision, the status would revert to partial. Pre-snapshot case results make this open, not open_stale.

corrections.why: F7: the record dates the event to the first public argument, 2023-10-02 (predates_frozen_revision: true), and states it 'found no indication the mathematical content ... was new to v2/v3'; revisions without shown new mathematics do not move the date. A pre-snapshot case result leaves the problem open, not open_stale (§4 step 5).
other: open status carries null direction (§4 step 6).
